title: Collection of Mammalian Embryonic Palate Tissue
author: Matthew Fox
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5tag6ie

steps.title: Euthanize pregnant mouse
steps.instruction: Perform IACUC‑approved CO₂ euthanasia at 2 L/min, continue until 1 minute after the last gasp, then complete cervical separation.

steps.title: Create abdominal incision
steps.instruction: Using scissors, cut an abdominal incision from the genitalia to the rib cage.

steps.title: Locate and lift embryos
steps.instruction: Locate both strands of embryos and lift them clear of all maternal organs.

steps.title: Free embryos from uterus
steps.instruction: Cut the tissues connecting the embryos anteriorly at the kidney and posteriorly at the base of the uterine horn.

steps.title: Transfer embryos to cold PBS
steps.instruction: Place the freed embryos into a 50 mL tube containing PBS on ice; keep embryos on ice until all sample collection is finished.

steps.title: Freeze adult carcass
steps.instruction: Place the euthanized adult mouse in a zip‑lock bag and store it in the Animal Room freezer.

steps.title: Remove embryos from uterine strand
steps.instruction: In a PBS‑filled dish, use micro‑scissors to separate each embryo from the uterine strand.

steps.title: Open amniotic sac
steps.instruction: Cut open the amniotic sac and cut the umbilical cord to free the embryo from the placenta.

steps.title: Remove embryo heads
steps.instruction: Excise the heads of the embryos and transfer them to a dish of clean PBS.

steps.title: Place heads under stereoscope
steps.instruction: Transfer each embryo head to a clean sorting dish and view under a stereoscope set to 1.75× magnification.

steps.title: Remove tongue and mandible
steps.instruction: Using micro‑scissors, remove the tongue and mandibular tissues from the embryo head.

steps.title: Excise palatal shelves
steps.instruction: Cut the tissues connecting the palatal shelves to the nasal palatal and maxillary processes to isolate the shelves.

steps.title: Transfer palate tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Place the isolated palate tissue into a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube kept on ice.

steps.title: Freeze palate tissue
steps.instruction: Preserve the palate tissue by freezing it at –80 °C in PBS solution.
